content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Telecom and media operator billing and network software; sells to communications providers, not manufacturers."},{"label":"C2","good":true,"reason":"Sells CAD, product design and simulation software to manufacturers and engineers, closely matching PTC's core design business."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Billing, customer care and payment software for pay-TV and telecom operators; a different customer base and product set."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Customer service and knowledge management software for enterprise contact centers; no design or manufacturing overlap."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Marketing data connectivity and identity software for brands and advertisers; unrelated to industrial design or lifecycle software."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Application development, data integration and IT infrastructure tools for IT teams; different buyers and products from PTC's manufacturing software."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Session border controllers and IP communications hardware and software for telecom carriers; a different business."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Social media and customer experience management platform for consumer-facing marketing and service teams; not manufacturing software."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Cloud work management, content and records software for enterprise and government back offices; no engineering or manufacturing focus."}]}
